tools.name: bash
tools.description: Run a shell command on the Linux workstation.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Download a business document by name.

tools.name: request_document
tools.description: Open a project request for a missing business document.

tools.name: list_document_requests
tools.description: List one page of project document requests.

tools.name: attach_requested_document
tools.description: Attach a document available in this workstation to an open project request.

tools.name: read_requested_document
tools.description: Read the document attached to a fulfilled project request.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create a draft supplier order using its supplier quote reference.

tools.name: approve_order
tools.description: Approve a draft supplier order against the cost-centre budget.

tools.name: issue_order
tools.description: Issue an approved supplier order and record its financial commitment.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel a draft or approved supplier order.

tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Read current supplier orders and recorded commitments.

tools.name: record_reconciliation
tools.description: Record issued purchase-order references and a brief reconciliation in the project register.
